Hymn 296: Our Father, by Whose Name
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: John David Edwards

This is hymn number 296 titled "Our Father, by Whose Name" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by John David Edwards and the lyrics were written by F. Bland Tucker.
